template: In the Ghost admin, open the draft post titled '{{v1}}' in the editor. First report what today's current date appears to be in the app (e.g. from the publish date picker or any timestamp). Then complete the publish flow: click the Publish button and confirm in the 'Ready to publish?' confirmation dialog. IMPORTANT: if the confirmation offers 'Schedule post' instead of 'Publish' (because the publish date {{v3}} is in the future), do NOT schedule it — instead report exactly what the dialog said and what options it offered, and leave the post unpublished. If it publishes successfully, report the resulting status of the post ({{v4}} / Scheduled / {{v5}}), the publish date shown, and whether the post is publicly visible at its URL {{v9}} (check by opening that URL in a new tab and reporting whether the post content loads publicly).

provenance.instruction: In the Ghost admin, open the draft post titled 'fwgh4-n1 Bench Post' in the editor. First report what today's current date appears to be in the app (e.g. from the publish date picker or any timestamp). Then complete the publish flow: click the Publish button and confirm in the 'Ready to publish?' confirmation dialog. IMPORTANT: if the confirmation offers 'Schedule post' instead of 'Publish' (because the publish date 2026-09-01 is in the future), do NOT schedule it — instead report exactly what the dialog said and what options it offered, and leave the post unpublished. If it publishes successfully, report the resulting status of the post (Published / Scheduled / Draft), the publish date shown, and whether the post is publicly visible at its URL http://127.0.0.1:8099/fwgh4-n1-bench-post/ (check by opening that URL in a new tab and reporting whether the post content loads publicly).
